mapper.sql: id, topic, message_key, message_value, created_at, delivery_attempt
mapper.select: INSERT INTO queue_message (topic, message_key, message_value, status, succeeded_at) VALUES (#{topic}, #{key}, #{value}, 'PENDING', NULL) RETURNING
SELECT FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND message_key = #{key} AND status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW() ORDER BY id
SELECT FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND message_key = #{key} AND status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW() ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT message_key AS key, MIN(id) AS oldest_message_id FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= NOW() AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM queue_message blocked WHERE blocked.topic = queue_message.topic AND blocked.message_key = queue_message.message_key AND blocked.status = 'PENDING' AND blocked.id < queue_message.id AND blocked.available_at > NOW() ) GROUP BY message_key HAVING COUNT(*) >= #{batchSize} ORDER BY MIN(id)
mapper.update: UPDATE queue_message SET status = 'PROCESSING', delivery_attempt = delivery_attempt + 1, lease_token = #{leaseToken}, lease_expires_at = #{leaseExpiresAt}, last_error_type = NULL WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND available_at <= #{now} AND id IN #{messageId}

UPDATE queue_message SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', succeeded_at = NOW(), lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, available_at = NOW(), last_error_type = NULL WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND id IN #{messageId}

UPDATE queue_message SET status = CASE WHEN delivery_attempt >= #{maxAttempts} THEN 'FAILED' ELSE 'PENDING' END, available_at = CASE WHEN delivery_attempt >= #{maxAttempts} THEN available_at ELSE #{retryAt} END, failed_at = CASE WHEN delivery_attempt >= #{maxAttempts} THEN #{now} ELSE CAST(NULL AS TIMESTAMPTZ) END, lease_token = NULL, lease_expires_at = NULL, last_error_type = #{errorType} WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND lease_token = #{leaseToken} AND id IN #{messageId}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'FAILED'
SELECT MIN(created_at) FROM queue_message WHERE topic = #{topic} AND status = 'PENDING'
